text:
deploy-bot: HOTPATCH ALERT v2026.3.2 -> eu-central1
deploy-bot: symptom=spike in p50/p95 latency for embed requests < 64 tokens, errors=timeout/retry, since 02:07 UTC, impact=search/autocomplete, severity=high
tori_release: noted. This came in right after quant-kernel bump in rollout v2026.3.2. Can we contain to a single cluster and rollback that cluster to last known-good?
sam_oncall: i'm on it. Confirmed increased retry counts on embed-fleet-eu-central-c. Heap/alloc charts show steady climb after cold-starts
alex_sre: suspect the new fused-attn kernel path causes increased transient memory usage under short sequences. Recommend pinning embed service to 2026.2.7 for eu-central1 and pausing further quant rollouts
gina: product asks for <30m mitigation. They want customer-facing note if we act. Also prefer minimal blast radius, please do pool-level rollback not global
devops-bot: deploy policy requires 2 approvers for out-of-window rollbacks. Current approvers online: tori_release, alex_sre
tori_release: I approve expedited pool rollback for embed-fleet-eu-central-c. :white_check_mark:
alex_sre: I approve as SRE. :thumbsup: keep canary traffic untouched in other regions
sam_oncall: ops plan: 1) set image for pool c to embed:v2026.2.7 2) cordon+drain 2 nodes hitting OOM-ish symptoms 3) watch for 15m 4) rollback if latency unchanged
sam_oncall: commands: ```rbctl set-image embed-fleet-eu-central embed-service:2026.2.7 --pool c
kubectl cordon node embed-eu-c-12
kubectl drain embed-eu-c-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
tori_release: add release note fragment: "Hotfix: revert embed service in eu-central1 pool-c to v2026.2.7 to mitigate increased transient memory usage after quant kernel change"
devops-bot: DEPLOY BEGIN: id=hotfix-1745678901, target=embed-fleet-eu-central pool=c, strategy=staggered
sam_oncall: started pool-c update now; routing weight shifted gradually to other pools by 10% increments
alex_sre: enable enhanced tracing for embed path for 20m: trace-sample=50%
sam_oncall: pool-c now running 2026.2.7, initial telemetry looks better p50 down ~20% p95 down ~15%
gina: good. Product requests to pin this image until 2026-05-04T06:00:00Z for extra validation. We need release signoff to keep outside normal change window
tori_release: approved to pin until 2026-05-04T06:00:00Z, contingent on postmortem. alex_sre also needs a postmortem and a follow-up test plan
alex_sre: ok to pin. Please disable auto rollback to latest for eu-central pool c until manual unpin
sam_oncall: pin command: `rbctl pin-image embed-fleet-eu-central pool=c embed-service:2026.2.7 --until 2026-05-04T06:00:00Z`
devops-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK DISABLED for embed-fleet-eu-central pool=c
config-note: added runbook entry and linked deploy id hotfix-1745678901 in ops-docs
tori_release: i'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for support and a brief internal release note
gina: support will hold off emailing until we hit 30m stable window. Thanks for fast approvals.
sam_oncall: monitoring shows stability at 22:18 UTC, keeping watch for another 30m then close
tori_release: expedited approvals collected in-thread (tori_release, alex_sre). Moving to incident->postmortem after stability window. :sparkles:
